title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer circuit-breaker thresholds during regional failover
author: Priya Desai
release_notes: Hotfix: Adjust SLO enforcer circuit-breaker/backoff thresholds to avoid cascading load-shedding during multi-region failover. No API changes.
body:
Motivation:
During the incident on 2026-02-14 (SUP-888) the SLO enforcer aggressively opened regional circuit breakers during a cascading latency spike, which triggered load-shedding in downstream regions and prolonged customer impact. This change tightens thresholds and introduces a short stabilization window to reduce thrash when regional metrics rebalance during failover.

What this PR does:
- Reduce the sensitivity of the regional circuit-breaker (raise error-rate and latency thresholds by configurable factors).
- Add a stabilization_window (10s) before the enforcer transitions from warn->open to prevent oscillation when transient spikes occur during traffic re-routing.
- Tweak backoff growth to use capped exponential backoff to avoid immediate long blackouts for marginal failures.
- Add additional metrics and tags for tracing which region and triggering rule caused the open to aid post-incident analysis.

Technical details (single continuous description):
This adjusts the SLO enforcer algorithm in services/slo-enforcer to prefer short, conservative shedding during global capacity events. The main parameters are now region_error_threshold (was 3s moving avg -> increased by 1.5x), region_latency_p95_threshold (raised by 20%), stabilization_window (10s default) and max_backoff_seconds (capped at 300s). Implementation includes config overrides from infra/config/slo_policies.yaml and runtime observable counters. No topology or schema changes.

Testing & validation:
- Unit tests added for transition logic and capped backoff (services/slo-enforcer/tests/test_failover.rs).
- Integration test that simulates regional failover and verifies at-most-one-open-per-region semantics (integration harness).
- Staged rollout plan: Canary on dedicated capacity in us-west-2 for 1 hour, then gradual scale to other regions.

Rollback plan:
- Revert helm chart values (helm-charts/slo-enforcer/values.yaml) to previous thresholds and redeploy. Config is dynamic and can be adjusted via SRE-runbooks without code rollback.

Related tickets: ENG-4213, incident SUP-888.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests added/updated
- [x] Integration test updated
- [x] Metrics and tracing added
- [x] Reviewed and approved by SRE
- [x] Canary tested in us-west-2
